about:
# NearestFlight

A small **World of Warcraft: Forever** addon that shows the flight masters
nearest to you on the world map, with distance and compass direction.

```
Nearest flight masters
Darkshire, Duskwood        412 yd  S
Lakeshire, Redridge        655 yd  SW
Stormwind, Elwynn          980 yd  W
```

It answers one question: *which flight master should I walk to from here?* It
is not a route planner and has no dependencies.

## Behaviour

- The panel sits in the lower left corner of the world map and refreshes while
  the map is open.
- The gear button on the panel opens the settings: number of flight masters,
  discovered points only, and yards or metres.
- Distances are **straight lines** from your character. Mountains, rivers and
  roads are not considered.
- Only flight masters on your continent that your faction can use are listed.
- Undiscovered flight points are shown in grey. The client reports this only
  while a flight map is open, so open one once per continent and character.
  Until then nothing is greyed out and the panel says so.
- Nothing is shown where the client reports no position, such as in instances.
- Flight master positions come from the client; the addon ships no data table.

## Installation

Copy the `NearestFlight` folder into the `Interface/AddOns/` folder of your
WoW: Forever installation, so that it contains
`NearestFlight/NearestFlight.toc`. If the game is running, log out to the
character selection (`/camp`) so the new addon is detected. After updating
files of an installed addon, `/reload` is enough.

## Commands

Everything in the settings window is also available as a command.

```
/nf              print the list to chat
/nf count <n>    number of flight masters listed, 1-10 (default 3)
/nf known        toggle: discovered flight points only
/nf unit yd|m    distance unit
/nf status       diagnostic information
```

`/nearestflight` works as the long form. English and German clients are
supported; other locales get English.

## Development

```
./test/run.sh    # syntax check and tests, Lua 5.1
./build.sh       # installable ZIP in dist/
```
